source: Original to this project, built with the SRD 5.2.1 rules (CC BY 4.0): the pregenerated Paladin. Standard Array as suggested for the Paladin (15, 10, 13, 8, 12, 14), Acolyte background (+2 Cha, +1 Wis; Insight, Religion), class skills Athletics and Persuasion, starting equipment A (Chain Mail, Shield, Longsword, 6 Javelins, 9 GP; Holy Symbol and Priest's Pack not modelled yet), Weapon Mastery: Longsword and Javelin.
